{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]]
==Ingredients==

=== Base ===
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (340 [[Cookbook:gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Pasta fresca all'uovo|pasta dough]] or 1 package of wonton wrappers
* Filling of choice (see below)

=== Fillings ===

* [[Cookbook:Ravioli/Cheese Filling|Cheese Filling]]
* [[Cookbook:Ravioli/Crab Meat Filling|Crab Meat Filling]]
* [[Cookbook:Ravioli/Fresh Herb and Cheese Filling|Fresh Herb and Cheese filling]]
* [[Cookbook:Ravioli/Meat Filling|Meat Filling]]
* [[Cookbook:Ravioli/Potato and Garlic Filling|Potato and Garlic Filling]]
* [[Cookbook:Ravioli/Smoked Salmon Filling|Smoked Salmon Filling]]
* [[Cookbook:Ravioli/Spinach and Ricotta Filling|Spinach and Ricotta Filling]]

==Procedure==

===Assembly===
[[Image:Ravioli-casalinghi-con-la-ricotta-2.jpg|thumb|Half-moon ravioli|308x308px]]

==== Method I ====
# Divide the pasta dough into 4 equal pieces.
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] one of these portions until it is about a 1/16-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (1.5 [[Cookbook:Mm|mm]]) thick rectangle.
# Roll out another the same size. Cover with a damp tea towel.
# Place about 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoonful]] of filling about every 2 inches (5 cm) across and down the rectangle of dough in a checker-board pattern.
# With a wet [[Cookbook:Brush|pastry brush]] or your index finger, paint lines down between the mounds of filling in a checker-board pattern.
#Carefully place the other sheet of pasta on top of the other one and press down around the mounds of filling firmly.
# With a sharp knife, pizza wheel or pastry cutter, cut the ravioli into individual squares.
# Crimp the edges with a fork. Besides being decorative, this ensures that they are well sealed.
# Process the other two portions of dough in the same way.

==== Method II ====
# Cut 3-inch (7.5 cm) diameter circles with a biscuit cutter, OR take one wonton wrapper.
# Place 1 tbsp of filling in the centre of a pasta circle or wonton wrapper, wet the edges, and cover with another circle. Alternatively, use half the amount of filling.
# Fold over one edge of the circle (or wonton wrapper) to the other edge to form a semi-circular shaped raviolo.
# Crimp the edges

===Cooking===
# Gently drop the ravioli into 1½–2 gallons (~8 liters) of gently [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] salted water. If boiling is too vigorous, the ravioli may break open.
# Stir gently with a heat-proof [[Cookbook:Spatula|spatula]] to prevent sticking. Contrary to the dictates of purists, you may add a little olive oil to the water if you wish.
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] the ravioli for about 8 minutes or until tender but not soft.
# Off the heat, remove the ravioli gently with a [[Cookbook:Slotted Spoon|slotted spoon]] or a [[Cookbook:Spider|spider]].
# Drain in a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]].
# Serve with tomato sauce, or with melted butter and Parmesan cheese.
